name: The Jailer
guide_text: Early [[Harmless Bonehead||104551]] is the best so you can hero power it on turn 3. You may also use your hero power on [[Cadaver Caretaker||113158]] midgame for free triples.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 3-5. Hero power the first instance of your buddy to easily fill out your board with Undeads so you can level fast.
